gloss: established pattern; standard move; textbook approach

definitions.explanation: In the board game Go, a well-studied sequence of moves that is considered optimal for both players in a given position.

definitions.gloss: established pattern; textbook approach; proven method
definitions.explanation: By extension, any well-established, proven approach or standard procedure in a field. Implies a method that has been tested and accepted as effective.

notes:
Originally a Go (⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧) term, now widely used figuratively in business, strategy, and daily life to mean "the standard/proven approach."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定石|じょうせき}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: according to the textbook approach
- {定石|じょうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to deviate from the standard
- {定石|じょうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break from convention
- {定石|じょうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: to follow established practice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {常套|じょうとう}⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: standard tactic — can have a negative nuance (hackneyed)
- セオリー: theory, standard practice — loanword, more casual
- ⟦{王道|おうどう}→王道：13505_oudou⟧: the royal road, the orthodox approach — implies the best or most legitimate method

USAGE:
Also read as ていせき in some contexts, though じょうせき is the standard reading.
